purpose: Manual behavior-evaluation cases; these are not an automated model benchmark.

cases.prompt: Evaluate a reported vulnerable transitive dependency before release.
expected_behaviors: Check current authoritative advisory and version sources if available
unacceptable_behaviors: Assume an audit is a full security guarantee

cases.prompt: Upgrade every package to latest in one patch.
expected_behaviors: Assess scope and breaking changes; recommend staged, tested updates

cases.prompt: Can we ship a dependency with an unclear license?
expected_behaviors: Flag legal uncertainty and identify authoritative license evidence needed
unacceptable_behaviors: Invent license or declare compliance without evidence
